expo.name: Open Arabic
expo.description: Learn Arabic through immersive reading, listening, and spaced repetition practice. Master vocabulary with authentic articles and audio content.

infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This app uses tracking to provide personalized learning analytics and improve your Arabic learning experience.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to your photo library to let you select a profile photo for your account.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to your camera to let you take a profile photo for your account.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app needs access to your microphone for audio recording features.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: This app sends study reminders to help you practice Arabic vocabulary at your scheduled times.
